title: Countries in both lists
statementMd:
Which countries appear among both artists and listeners?

Expected columns: `country`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT country FROM artists INTERSECT SELECT country FROM listeners;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
